jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
This is a part-time, remote role for a Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst. The role involves monitoring transactions and account activity to identify potential fraud, financial crime, or unusual patterns that may indicate risk. The analyst will review alerts, conduct detailed investigations, and document findings in clear, concise reports. Responsibilities include assessing risk exposure, recommending controls or mitigations, and supporting compliance with relevant policies and regulations. The role also requires collaborating with internal stakeholders to improve fraud detection strategies, maintaining accurate records, and staying informed about emerging fraud trends and typologies in financial services.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong analytical skills and risk analysis capabilities to interpret data, identify patterns, and assess potential fraud or financial crime.
Candidates should possess foundational knowledge in finance and statistics to understand banking products, transaction flows, and quantitative risk indicators.
Candidates should possess clear and effective communication skills to prepare reports, explain findings, and collaborate with internal teams.
Candidates should possess attention to detail, integrity, and sound judgment when handling sensitive financial information and making risk decisions.
Relevant experience in fraud risk, financial crime, compliance, or audit within financial services is beneficial.
A degree or ongoing studies in finance, economics, statistics, business, law, or a related field are beneficial.
Familiarity with banking regulations, KYC/AML concepts, and basic data analysis tools or spreadsheets is an advantage.

Employment type

Industries
